# Command Vehicle Assets

The __command vehicle__ is your interstellar STARSHIP. It is a default asset for your character, taken when you begin your campaign. If you are playing with others, this is a shared asset; each of you may use the STARSHIP's abilities while aboard the craft.

The command vehicle has an integrity meter and starts at 5 integrity. When your STARSHIP takes a hit, make the Withstand Damage move to see what happens.

## Starship

*Fill in:* name  
*Track:* integrity meter: starts at 5, max 5; can be marked battered, cursed  
*Shared asset.*  
*Attachments:* module assets

- [x] Your armed, multipurpose starship is suited for interstellar and atmospheric flight. It can comfortably transport several people, has space for cargo, and can carry and launch support vehicles. When you Advance, you may spend experience to equip this vehicle with module assets.
- [ ] When you Finish an Expedition (dangerous or greater) in your starship and score a hit, this journey strengthened your ties to your ship and any fellow travelers. You and your allies may mark 1 tick on your bonds legacy track.
- [ ] When you Withstand Damage, you may roll +heart. If you do, Endure Stress (-1) on a weak hit or miss.
